# MobiDev

> > MobiDev is a software development company specializing in AI/ML, AR, IoT, and enterprise web and mobile applications with expertise in healthcare, fintech, and retail technology.

MobiDev provides full-cycle software development services including web and mobile application development, product scaling, and technology consulting. The company has deep expertise in Python/Django, compliance-focused solutions (HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS), and emerging technologies like augmented reality, digital twins, and AI-powered automation for retail and healthcare sectors.

## Key Topics

- AI & Machine Learning
- Augmented Reality (AR)
- HIPAA Compliance
- Python & Django Development
- Healthcare Technology
- Retail Technology & Automation
- Fintech Security
- IoT Integration
- SaaS & SPA Development
- Computer Vision
- HR Analytics
- Digital Twin Technology
- Cross-platform Mobile Development
- Data Science & PostgreSQL
- PCI DSS & GDPR Compliance
